thread:
Claudia: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need clear owners and dates for the KV-cache/oom remediation items. putting a short checklist here, please ack and add ETA.

Claudia: items: 1) run jemalloc + fragmentation profiling in prod canary 2) GC/config tuning for kv_cache compaction 3) add automated OOM regression test + nightly check 4) limit enforcement and graceful fallback policy 5) investigate weekly fragmentation spike pattern

Ravi: I can take profiling (1). will run jemalloc + tcmalloc stacks on canary. ETA EOD Tue. need a short runbook for how to collect safely.

Claudia: perfect. Ravi can you paste the exact commands you want?

Ravi: sure. example commands:
```bash
sudo jeprof --web /proc/$(pidof redwood-runtime)/heap.profile
pprof --pdf /usr/bin/redwood-runtime heap.profile > heap.pdf
# and capture jemalloc stats via: echo stats | nc /var/run/jemalloc.sock > jemalloc.stats
```

Marisol: I'll own item 2 (GC/config tuning + compaction). planning a small rolling change: decrease max_cache_retention -> 6h, enable background_compact: true, and add forced compaction window during low traffic. ETA 2 weeks.

Jon: I'll take 3 (regression test). plan: nightly fuzz of worst-case prompts + mem-check harness, gate on canary before prod deploy. ETA 1 week for PoC.

sre-oncall: FYI, we've consistently seen a fragmentation spike every Wednesday ~03:00 UTC last 6 weeks. that's probably why some OOMs aligned with backups. logging the pattern in the ticket.

Claudia: good catch. can we add a scheduled compaction job to run Wed 04:00 UTC after backups? Marisol: would that conflict with your compaction window?

Marisol: not if we do a low-priority, token-limited compaction. i'll add a cronjob config and a circuit-breaker so it won't run if CPU > 60%.

Ravi: for profiling we should also snapshot the KV slab distributions: run `kvctl slab-stats --format json` and upload to the incident S3. I'll annotate hotspot keys.

Claudia: ownership recap: Ravi (profiling) — ETA Tue EOD; Marisol (GC + scheduled compaction) — ETA 2w; Jon (regression/nightly) — ETA 1w; Claudia (coord/rollout + verify metrics) — next check-in Wed sync.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: redwood/runtime@canary -> 1799555000 (automatic). :information_source:

InfraBot: alert: disk-snap-backup ran 1799549800, duration 42m. correlated with memory spike window.

Jon: quick note on tests — I'll add a golden baseline for KV-cache memory usage and a slack alert if 95p > baseline + 20%.

Claudia: excellent. action items to the incident ticket and please add short PRs with config diffs. also add a short eval prompt set to catch the worst-case growth path.

Ravi: uploading jemalloc + slab dumps to s3://redwood-incidents/1799554321/ now. link: https://s3.redwood/1799554321/

Marisol: draft compaction YAML (will PR):
```yaml
compaction:
  enabled: true
  schedule: "0 4 * * 3" # Wed 04:00 UTC
  cpu_threshold: 60
  max_duration: 30m
  priority: low
  token_limit: 1000
```

sre-oncall: adding a recurring pager-check to validate compaction didn't overlap backups next week.

Claudia: thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with owners/times and mark follow-ups. next sync: Wed sync 10:30am PT. :spiral_calendar:

Marisol: ack :thumbsup:

Ravi: ack :eyes:

Jon: ack

sre-oncall: ack

Claudia: closing thread for now, keep updates in the ticket and drop short notes here if anything blocks.
